summary: Backend testing of FX2026 bulk-imported users (import_source='fx2026_xlsx'). All 10 pytest cases PASS. Confirmed: (1) imported users login with FX2026, (2) bcrypt-hashed passwords (starts with $2), wrong password returns 401, (3) country_name='España', country_code='ES', role='user', account_status='active', import_source='fx2026_xlsx' persisted in DB, (4) auto-provisioned checking account present in accounts collection, (5) idempotency preserved – gsalazar1@gmail.com preserved (no import_source, no FX2026 password) and admin admi@paylionsbit.es fully intact with role=admin, (6) CRITICAL email pipeline integration verified – POST /api/admin/broadcast with audience='single' targeting an imported user returned success/recipients=1/in_app_sent=1/emails_queued=1, in-app notification appeared in GET /api/notifications, and email_logs collection recorded the send with status='sent' using the same send_email_background/Resend pipeline used platform-wide, (7) welcome in-app notification present for imported user.

minor.issue: Hard-capped at 1000 users with no search/pagination; with ~3270 users, most imported accounts are invisible via this endpoint. Admin UI listings/searches will silently miss users. Consider adding server-side pagination + search (email/name) filter.
Does not expose country_name/country_code/import_source; frontend cannot easily localize UI or show origin for imported users without extra calls.

action_items: Consider adding pagination + search to GET /api/admin/users (currently limited to first 1000 out of 3270).
Optional: expose country/import_source in /auth/me if the frontend needs to differentiate imported users.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py::admin_get_users limits to 1000 with no search — will hide the majority of imported users in admin UI listings.
services/email.py properly logs every send to email_logs collection with status; broadcast reuses this pipeline so imported users are fully integrated.
scripts/import_fx2026_users.py idempotency verified: pre-existing users NOT overwritten (gsalazar1 kept its own password, no import_source flag).
